args.summary:
Model completed successfully for a 3-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box girder bridge (30+45+30 m, deck 12.5 m, C55, single-cell box h=2.2 m).

Modeling approach:
- structure.idealization = spine_beam_2d; structure.system = continuous_on_piers (both piers have column geometry, so pier columns are modeled as elastic beam-column elements, fixed at base; twin 1.4 m circles merged into a single column: A=3.0788 m², I=0.3771 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa, H=6 m / 29 m).
- Girder: A=7.05 m², I=4.7775 m⁴ (integrated cast-box section), Ec=35500 MPa (C55, JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5), γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), w=183.3 kN/m, m=18.685 t/m.
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, 2 per line, modeled as zero-length springs; Ge=1.2 MPa from the manufacturer's test value): Abutments 0/3 PTFE sliding (400×500, 5×11 mm), Pier 1 plain elastomeric fixed (600×700, 7×11 mm, Kh=13091 kN/m), Pier 2 PTFE sliding (550×650, 6×11 mm). Sliding supports have Kh=0 (longitudinally free); all have vertical spring Kv computed per JTG 3362-2018 8.7 (Ee=5.4·Ge·S²). Shape factors S: 10.10 / 14.69 / 13.54 / 10.10.
- Live load (Highway Class I, JTG D60-2015): 3 lanes, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/350/320 kN by span. Impact factor μ=0.192 from f1=3.239 Hz (4.3.2).

Key results: first vertical bending frequency f1 = 3.239 Hz; total girder self-weight support reactions 1811/7843/7735/1858 kN (sum ≈ 19246 kN); self-weight midspan moments 6546/18945/7244 kNm; maximum live-load positive moment 11254 kNm (mid span 2) and negative moment −8975 kNm (support 1). All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
